{"metadata":{"description":"Bookmark assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness: per-message bookmarks with notes/tags, a cross-session center, and one-click Markdown export.","id":"gh:1334251671","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-bookmarks","slug":"penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks","topics":["bookmark","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","web"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Bookmark assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness: per-message bookmarks with notes/tags, a cross-sessi"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"on center, and one-click Markdown export."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-bookmarks"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"[](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) [](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks/actions/workflows"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/) [](https://github.com/penguin-oo/dsh-bookmarks/actions/workflows/ci.yml)"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Bookmark assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI: bookmark any finalized assistant reply "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"with a note and tags, browse every bookmark from every session in one center panel, and export them "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"to Markdown in one click."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"中文说明"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Screenshots"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Per-message bookmark** — an archive button on each finalized assistant reply (right next to the "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"👍/👎 feedback buttons), with an inline editor for a note and comma-separated tags.
- **Server-derived"},{"id":"p8s3","text":" snippet** — the bookmark stores a text preview of the actual reply, so the center stays useful even"},{"id":"p8s4","text":" without a note.
- **Cross-session center** — one panel listing bookmarks from all sessions and work"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"spaces, with full-text search, tag filter, inline editing and deletion.
- **Jump back** — every entr"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"y opens its session in one click.
- **Markdown export** — one click downloads all bookmarks as `dsh-"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"bookmarks.md`.
- **Keyboard** — `Alt+B` toggles the center from anywhere.
- **Safe writes** — per-it"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"em compare-and-set versions (multi-tab safe), server-side validation, and durable storage via the DS"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"t versions (multi-tab safe), server-side validation, and durable storage via the DSH storage domain."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Then restart DSH (`dsh web`). The plugin appends itself to the profile bundle layer automatically; n"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"othing else to configure."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"For a local checkout:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## Config"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"The bundle row exposes three limits (all optional):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Key | Default | Meaning |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `maxNoteBytes` | `4096` | Max UTF-8 bytes of one note (`""` clears a note; omitting the field keep"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"s it). |
| `maxSnippetChars` | `300` | Max characters of the server-derived reply snippet. |
| `maxT"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ags` | `8` | Max tags per bookmark; each tag ≤ 32 chars, trimmed and deduplicated. |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Override them in the profile patch layer (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"One npm package hosts both halves of the plugin:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- **Host half** (`lib/index.js`) — the `bookmarks` Remote service (Typert), backed by a storage-doma"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"in table (`$DSH_HOME/storages/bookmarks.json`). `put` inspects the persisted session log to validate"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" the target reply and derive its snippet, mirrors the official `message-feedback` durability barrier"},{"id":"p22s4","text":", and serializes mutations with per-item version tokens.
- **Browser half** (`src/client`, bundled t"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"o `lib/client.js`) — mounts the Remote contribution through `ctx.remote.$mount`, then registers two "},{"id":"p22s6","text":"UI slots: `conversation.chat.assistant-actions` (the per-message button) and `sidebar.footer.action`"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" (the center toggle)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`lib/client.js` is committed and shipped; no build step runs on install."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"- Bookmarks are stored in one global row: fine for personal use, not a shared multi-user store.
- Th"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"e center panel jumps to the bookmarked *session*; it does not auto-scroll to the exact message yet.
"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"- The panel toggle lives in the sidebar footer; use `Alt+B` when the sidebar is collapsed."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
